name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,617 on 26 Nov, 1.9% lower on the week and 20% lower over three months
state: Gold futures were near $3,617 early on 26 Nov, 1.9% lower on the week, 10.7% lower on the month, 20.1% lower over three months and about 32% below the 52-week high of $5,318 (Yahoo Finance). The worst day in five sessions was -4.6%, and the weekly move is inside the 7% Alert line, leaving the three-month fall of more than 8% in the Watch band.
for_you: Gold's sharp fall from its peak signals shifting market conditions; holders of gold or gold funds have seen large valuation swings.
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
